kaikki_vikisozluk.e: دُنْيَا • (dunyā) f (dual دُنْيَيَان (dunyayān), plural دُنًا (dunan, construct state دُنَا (dunā)) or دُنًى (dunan, construct state دُنَى (dunā)) or دُنْيَيَات (dunyayāt))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t:
Etymology tree
Arabic دَنِيّ (daniyy)
Arabic أَدْنَى (ʔadnā)
Arabic دُنْيَا
Feminine elative of أَدْنَى (ʔadnā, “lower”). دُنيَا (“world”) is originally the "lower place" (as opposed to heaven, the "higher place"); compare English here below.
